Developer-Led Delivery Model

A 5-Stage Roadmap for Salesforce Engineering

We treat Salesforce like a robust enterprise software platform: requirements become architecture, architecture becomes tested code, and releases move through safe environments before production.

01

Map Workflows & Boundaries

Clarify business workflows, user personas, data ownership, permission matrices, external API boundaries, and where Salesforce uniquely fits.

02

Architect Schema & Interfaces

Define custom objects, indexes, Apex service layer interfaces, sandbox topologies, and CI/CD change management plans.

03

Build, Integrate & Test

Develop Lightning Web Components, bulkified Apex triggers, Flow automations, unit tests with >90% coverage, and external API connectors.

04

Sandbox QA & Acceptance

Validate functionality in full-copy sandboxes, conduct user acceptance testing (UAT), review Shield encryption, and verify rollback plans.

05

Deploy & Managed Support

Execute safe deployment via Salesforce CLI / GitHub Actions, monitor Governor limits, train admin teams, and deliver <24h production SLA support.

Frequently Asked Questions

Salesforce Partner Engineering FAQ

Answers to common questions about our Salesforce partner status, custom development vs configuration, code coverage standards, and SLA guarantees.

Why choose custom LWC & Apex over standard CRM configuration?
Standard configuration is suitable for basic lead capture, but growing businesses quickly hit Governor limits, sluggish page loads, and rigid UI constraints. By building with Lightning Web Components (LWC) and clean Apex architecture, we give your team custom enterprise interfaces, millisecond-fast data operations, and complete freedom from AppExchange licensing fees.
What code test coverage standards does Coralgenz maintain?
While Salesforce requires a minimum 75% test coverage for deployment, Coralgenz enforces a strict >90% code coverage policy across all Apex triggers, batch classes, and controller services. We write realistic unit tests with comprehensive positive, negative, and bulk data scenarios, guaranteeing zero deployment failures during seasonal platform releases.
Can you connect Salesforce to our custom backend or ERP?
Yes. We regularly build high-volume data integrations between Salesforce and external platforms including SAP, NetSuite, Azure SQL, AWS PostgreSQL, and custom RESTful Node.js/Python APIs. We design resilient retry-safe architectures using Named Credentials, Platform Events, and webhook queues to ensure zero data loss during network hiccups.
Do we retain 100% ownership of the developed Salesforce code?
Yes. All custom code, Lightning components, Apex triggers, Flows, documentation, and Git repository branches belong 100% to your organization upon project completion. We do not lock our clients into proprietary managed packages or recurring developer licensing royalties.
What is your support SLA for production issues?
Our enterprise partner SLA guarantees response and triage within <24h for critical production defects. Clients on our managed retainers have direct access to senior engineering leads, scheduled sprint planning sessions, and proactive Governor limit audits.
